fact: Tech Rek states the Khadamati app, which groups more than 15 digital public services, relies on Houwiyeti to verify users' national identity (as_of is the article's published date, 2026-08-11).

Tech Rek states Houwiyeti is the gateway public and private services use to verify citizens' identity, with private financial apps using the identity verification system at user registration alongside the public Khadamati services (as_of is the published date).

ID Tech Wire reports a TECH5/SmartMS/UNDP pilot for MTNIMA, demonstrated in March 2023, in which a citizen matches an e-passport or ID card by selfie, stores a digital ID on the phone and uses biometric login to the government e-services portal, leading to the Houwiyeti app launched in 2024.
system: Government e-services portal (biometric login with digital ID)
